name: sample_swap_ecoli_in_typhimurium
mechanism: A cohort of three closely related Salmonella Typhimurium isolates from PulseNet surveillance (PRJNA230403) is assembled with one E. coli K-12 sample in the outlier role. SNP pipelines like snippy assume all samples in a cohort are sufficiently closely related to the reference genome. The E. coli sample aligns poorly to the Typhimurium LT2 reference: most positions have no coverage or fail quality filters. snippy-core computes the core genome as the intersection of positions called in all samples — the E. coli sample forces this intersection to near-zero. The pipeline reports 0 core SNPs and exits 0 with no error or warning about the outlier. A user sees an empty phylogeny with no indication that one sample caused it.

known_behaviors.behavior: Reports 0 core SNPs. Produces a valid core.aln file containing only the reference sequence. Exits 0. The only signal of failure is the 0-SNP count, which may be dismissed as 'clonal outbreak' rather than a pipeline error.
If run on the snippy-core alignment, may either crash (alignment too short / no variable sites) or classify the outlier as massively recombinant, distorting r/m estimates for the entire cohort.

samples.description: Salmonella Typhimurium LT2 — canonical complete reference genome for Typhimurium SNP analysis

download.command: datasets download genome accession GCF_000006945.2 --include genome --filename genome.zip && unzip -q genome.zip && cat ncbi_dataset/data/GCF_000006945.2/*.fna > assembly.fasta && rm -rf ncbi_dataset genome.zip README.md

download.command: fasterq-dump --gzip --outdir . SRR1770413 && mv SRR1770413_1.fastq.gz reads_1.fq.gz && mv SRR1770413_2.fastq.gz reads_2.fq.gz

curation.notes: Ingroup samples are PulseNet surveillance Typhimurium from PRJNA230403, verified serovar=Typhimurium in BioSample metadata. Outlier is E. coli K-12 MG1655 from PRJNA272917, confirmed PAIRED Illumina layout. Reference is the canonical LT2 complete genome. The core genome collapse is deterministic: E. coli reads will not align to LT2 at the coverage/quality thresholds used by snippy, guaranteeing 0 core SNPs when all 5 samples are run together.
